Seit Mitte Oktober 2026 läuft bei uns die ticketbro Kasse im Echtbetrieb, mit Stripe Terminal direkt am Tresen. Weitere Betreiber folgen. Für die Kasse suchen wir jemanden, der sie komplett übernimmt: Code, Rollout und die Betreuung der Anwender. Deine Aufgaben Du bist verantwortlich für die ticketbro Kasse, vom Cloud-Backend bis zur Oberfläche am Terminal. Du entwickelst neue Features und behebst Fehler, idealerweise basierend auf deinen eigenen Beobachtungen vor Ort. Du bist Ansprechperson für Betreiber bei technischen Rückfragen, gelegentlich auch am Wochenende. Du richtest die Kasse bei Bedarf direkt beim Betreiber ein und schulst das Team vor Ort. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, um die Kasse im Alltag effizienter und benutzerfreundlicher zu gestalten. Dein Profil Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, gute Englischkenntnisse. Erfahrung mit React oder React Native und TypeScript sowie Grundkenntnisse in Node.js und AWS Lambda (Projekte aus Studium, Praktikum oder eigene Arbeiten sind ausreichend). Du kannst komplexe Technik verständlich erklären und behältst auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf. Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in GraphQL, AWS CDK, Erfahrung mit Payment- oder Kassensystemen sowie ein Führerschein der Klasse B. Du wohnst idealerweise in München, dies ist jedoch keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Was wir bieten Echte Verantwortung für ein Produkt, das bei Betreibern live im Einsatz ist. Anstellung als Werkstudent mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten oder in Vollzeit, unbefristet. Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und bei Vollzeit 30 Tage Urlaub. Hochwertiges Equipment. Flache Hierarchien und direkter Austausch mit dem Management. Büro in München. Bewerbung Schick uns ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben, einen Link zu GitHub oder zu einem Projekt, dein frühestmögliches Startdatum und deine Gehaltsvorstellung (als Werkstudent: Stunden pro Woche). Beant

jobs.description: Unser Auftraggeber steht seit über 60 Jahren für Kompetenz, Verlässlichkeit und erstklassigen Service rund um PKW und Nutzfahrzeuge. Mit Leidenschaft, Fachwissen und einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch sorgt das Team täglich dafür, dass Kunden mobil bleiben und sich auf ihre Fahrzeuge verlassen können. Als Teil einer starken Unternehmensgruppe verbindet das Unternehmen langjährige Erfahrung im Fahrzeugservice mit moderner Mobilitätskompetenz und schafft dadurch optimale Lösungen für seine Kunden. Als Leiter Finanzen & Rechnungswesen (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Gesamtverantwortung für die kaufmännische Steuerung des Unternehmens. Sie verantworten die Bereiche Finanz- und Rechnungswesen, Controlling sowie die kaufmännische Verwaltung und stellen eine wirtschaftliche, effiziente und rechtssichere Organisation sicher. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsleitung entwickeln Sie strategische und operative Ziele und führen Ihr Team erfolgreich in die Zukunft. Im Rahmen einer strukturierten Einarbeitung wachsen Sie schrittweise in die Gesamtverantwortung hinein. Geboten werden spannende Aufgaben, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und ein Arbeitsumfeld mit echtem Zusammenhalt. Werden Sie Teil dieses erfolgreichen Teams. Für den Standort in Hohenlinden suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt SIE als: Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) als kaufm. jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description: About GlassFlow GlassFlow builds data infrastructure for AI agents in production, featuring two core products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data across systems, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs agent behavior. Operating as a Berlin startup backed by Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, and the ex-CTO of Aiven, the team comprises serial entrepreneurs with over 10 years of experience. What you will do As a Founding Engineer, you will shape the platform's technical foundation in a hybrid role based in Berlin. You will collaborate directly with the founders to build and scale the infrastructure supporting AI agents. Product Integration for Client Use Cases Go-to Person for technical questions for the internal sales and marketing team Building and developing the connector and ingestion layer Part of the core development team Creation of product tutorials and guides What the role requires This permanent position is offered at 40 hours per week with a 6-month probation period. You will work within a small, fast-paced team environment. You are: Fluent in Python Knowledge of frontend frameworks like TypeScript and React is a plus Experience with public or private clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure) Experience with DevOps (Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions) Worked in fast-growing environments and/or early-stage startups Willing to work once a week in our Berlin office Your first months at GlassFlow You will dive straight into the core architecture, collaborating on initial feature rollouts for GlassFlow Tares and GlassFlow Rius. During your first months, you will establish foundational engineering workflows and contribute directly to the production codebase. Working environment and perks You will receive company stock options and flexible working hours to manage your schedule. The role includes public transportation benefits, home office options, and complete home office equipment alongside a company laptop and travel expenses compensation. Additional pro

jobs.description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company s DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant* – Securities & Custody Operations
jobs.description: Standort: Frankfurt / München (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Capital Markets | Anstellungsart: Unbefristet Gestalte die Zukunft von Securities & Custody Operations im Finanzdienstleistungssektor. Die Rolle Als (Senior) Consultant* in unserer Capital Markets Practice arbeitest Du mit führenden Finanzinstituten zusammen, um deren Securities-, Custody- und Capital-Markets-Operations zu transformieren und zu optimieren. Du bringst fundierte Fachkenntnisse entlang des Wertpapier-Lebenszyklus und im Post-Trade-Umfeld mit. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden analysierst Du komplexe operative Herausforderungen, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und übersetzt Anforderungen in praxisorientierte Lösungen. Du begleitest Transformationsprogramme von der Analyse und Konzeption bis hin zur Implementierung und arbeitest dabei eng mit Stakeholdern aus Operations, Technologie und Change zusammen. Was Du bei uns machst Du unterstützt Transformationsinitiativen in den Bereichen Securities, Custody und Post-Trade Operations – von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur Implementierung. Du analysierst bestehende Operating Models, Prozesse und Kontrollen und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Vereinfachung, Optimierung und Effizienzsteigerung. Du arbeitest mit Stakeholdern aus Business, Operations und Technologie zusammen, definierst Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in praxisorientierte Lösungen. Du setzt Dein Wissen über Wertpapierprozesse ein – einschließlich Trade Lifecycle, Settlement, Asset Servicing und Custody Operations – um komplexe Herausforderungen unserer Kunden zu lösen. Du unterstützt die Projektdurchführung durch Workshops, Analysen, Dokumentation, Stakeholder Management und Implementierungsbegleitung. Was wir von Dir erwarten Relevante Beratungs- oder Finanzdienstleistungserfahrung in den Bereichen Securities, Custody, Post-Trade oder Capital Markets Operations. jobs.title: Founding Robotics Engineer Navigation & Autonomy
jobs.description: ABOUT NAXON Naxon Robotics deploys swarms of mobile robots, quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, for security and industrial inspection. The fleet patrols perimeters, detects anomalies and inspects assets as one coordinated system, covering more ground 24/7 , delivering more value and reaching ROI faster than a single robot or a fleet of disconnected ones. Why now : rising threats to critical infrastructure, too few people in security and industry , cheap and reliable hardware and fast moving AI agents. Hardware is ready . Deployment is not. Every new site is still a months-long expert project, so pilots rarely turn into rollouts. We make deployment repeatable, with swarms and an agentic platform that learns from each site. Backed by EWOR, TUM VLABs and a robotics founder who built and exited a drone swarm company . Mentored by unicorn founders and Prof. Johannes Betz (autonomous driving and robotics, TUM). THE ROLE You own the autonomy stack every robot in our fleet runs on: SLAM, localisation and navigation, indoors and outdoors, across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones. You take it from the lab to production at customer sites and keep it robust there. As the fleet grows, you grow the stack into multi robot coordination. This is the core the whole company scales on. You own the stack. The Field Robotics Engineer owns what runs at the customer. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build and own SLAM, localisation, mapping and navigation, indoor and outdoor Select, combine and calibrate sensors: lidar , depth, RGB, thermal, IMU and GNSS Generalise the stack across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones Test and tune on real robots with benchmarks and field data, not only in simulation Define what runs on the robot and what runs in the cloud, including failure and fallback Take the stack to production at customer sites, then extend it to multi robot coordination WHAT YOU BRING Has taken SLAM or an autonomy stack to production at real customers, not only research demos Strong in SLA

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: About Isembard Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics. The role This role sits where MasonOS meets the shop floor. Every new factory in our network adds training, adoption and support work. You will embed with factories and network sites, own their success with MasonOS end to end, ship production code, apply AI to their workflows and build the tools that make each new site easier than the last. It is not a support role. It is a build role, deployed forward, defining a new function rather than filling a seat. You will be based at our Hamburg factory, with roughly 30 to 50 per cent of your time embedded at other sites. We are open to graduate and experienced engineers. The package includes equity. Run onboarding, training and day-to-day adoption with machinists, engineers and site operators. Turn repeated support questions into playbooks, training material or self-service tools. You are measured on the support burden falling, not on tickets closed. Put agentic workflows into operational use: reporting, supplier follow-ups and order status. jobs.title: Machine Learning Researcher
jobs.description: About the Position We’re looking for smart and curious individuals to join our growing team and drive our ML work. On our Machine Learning team, you ll build the deep learning models that power our trading strategies, supported by our rapidly growing computing cluster with tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. You’ll train models for the next generation of our deep learning-based trading strategies, and build the fundamental understanding we need to tackle new markets and situations. jobs.description: We are looking for a Research Engineer with robust experience in machine learning and strong mathematical foundations to join our growing ML team and to help drive the direction of our ML platform. jobs.title: Machine Learning Performance Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for an engineer with experience in low-level systems programming and optimisation to join our growing ML team.  Machine learning is a critical pillar of Jane Street s global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. Your part here is optimising the performance of our models – both training and inference. We care about efficient large-scale training, low-latency inference in real-time systems and high-throughput inference in research. Part of this is improving straightforward CUDA, but the interesting part needs a whole-systems approach, including storage systems, networking and host- and GPU-level considerations. Zooming in, we also want to ensure our platform makes sense even at the lowest level – is all that throughput actually goodput? Does loading that vector from the L2 cache really take that long? If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in.  There’s no fixed set of skills, but here are some of the things we’re looking for: An understanding of modern ML techniques and toolsets The experience and systems knowledge required to debug a training run’s performance end to end Low-level GPU knowledge of PTX, SASS, warps, cooperative groups, Tensor Cores and the memory hierarchy Debugging and optimisation experience using tools like CUDA GDB, NSight Systems, NSight Computesight-systems and nsight-compute Library knowledge of Triton, CUTLASS, CUB, Thrust, cuDNN and cuBLAS Intuition about the latency and throughput characteristics of CUDA graph launch, tensor core arithmetic, warp-level synchronization and asynchronous memory loads Background in Infiniband, RoCE, GPUDirect, PXN, rail optimisation and NVLin

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineering Intern: System 1 Models for Reactive Space Operations
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Our AI for Space team is looking for a motivated intern to explore how fast, lightweight “System 1” models can boost reactivity, performance, and usability across our satellite operational chains. Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. This internship will assess that added value and prototype it on our reactivity scenarios. Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station) Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027. About this role: Review the state of the art on System 1 / fast, intuitive models and compare them with the System 2 models used today, including our partners' models. Map where System 1 models could bring value in our operational chain for reactivity use cases, from detection to tasking. Define benchmark scenarios of increasing complexity with the team: a single-satellite reactive loop, then a two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue loop, and, as a stretch goal, a multi-satellite scenario. Set the latency budget, accuracy needs, and execution context for each scenario. Build datasets and evaluation sets from Loft data, partner outputs, and open datasets. Train or fine-tune System 1 models and benchmark them against System 2 baselines on reactivity (latency), performance (accuracy, compute footprint), and ease of use (integration and operational effort). Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris. Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée. Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation

jobs.description: Over ons Europa verandert. Steeds meer mensen kiezen voor vrijheid — als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Ze bepalen zelf wanneer, hoe en met wie ze werken. Maar die vrijheid komt met een keerzijde: onzekerheid. Bij Insify geloven we dat ondernemers zich geen zorgen moeten maken over verzekeringen. Daarom bouwen we iets wat de verzekeringswereld hard nodig heeft: transparante, eerlijke en volledig digitale verzekeringen, speciaal voor mensen die voor zichzelf werken. Geen ingewikkeld papierwerk, geen gedoe. Vandaag geregeld, morgen verzekerd. We verzekeren inmiddels duizenden klanten in heel Europa — en we zijn nog maar net begonnen. Het Operations Team Wij zijn het gezicht van Insify. Bij elk telefoontje, elke e-mail en elk gesprek bouwen we vertrouwen op. We zorgen ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord, gesteund en goed geholpen voelen — ook als het ingewikkeld wordt. jobs.title: Junior Solution Architect
jobs.description: Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar de wereld van GEO-data, architectuur en digitale innovatie binnen de overheid? Wil je werken aan oplossingen die dagelijks impact hebben op Nederland? Dan is de rol van Solution Architect GIS/GEO bij DICTU precies wat bij jou past. In deze functie werk je op de ICT-afdeling van DICTU, waar je bijdraagt aan geografische producten en diensten die door meerdere ministeries worden gebruikt. Je leert hoe complexe GIS-vraagstukken worden vertaald naar heldere architecturen en robuuste oplossingen. Je ontwikkelt je tot een expert die de brug vormt tussen DevOps-teams, architecten en opdrachtgevers. Solution Architect GIS/GEO Als Solution Architect GIS/GEO speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerpen, standaardiseren en verbeteren van GEO-diensten. Je ontwikkelt productarchitecturen op basis van functionele en niet-functionele eisen en maakt slim gebruik van rijksbrede standaarden zoals NORA, EAR, BIO en de AVG. Je werkt nauw samen met scrum teams en Product Owners binnen het SAFe-framework en legt jouw keuzes vast volgens het DICTU Agile Architectuurproces, gebaseerd op TOGAF. Je adviseert, overtuigt en neemt collega’s mee in jouw visie. Je ziet de samenhang tussen processen, data en systemen, en begrijpt hoe krachtig GIS-functionaliteit kan zijn in die keten. jobs.description: ABOUT NAXON Naxon Robotics deploys swarms of mobile robots, quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, for security and industrial inspection. The fleet patrols perimeters, detects anomalies and inspects assets as one coordinated system, covering more ground 24/7 , delivering more value and reaching ROI faster than a single robot or a fleet of disconnected ones. Why now : rising threats to critical infrastructure, too few people in security and industry , cheap and reliable hardware and fast moving AI agents. Hardware is ready . Deployment is not. Every new site is still a months-long expert project, so pilots rarely turn into rollouts. We make deployment repeatable, with swarms and an agentic platform that learns from each site. Backed by EWOR, TUM VLABs and a robotics founder who built and exited a drone swarm company . Mentored by unicorn founders and Prof. Johannes Betz (autonomous driving and robotics, TUM). You take it from the lab to production at customer sites and keep it robust there. As the fleet grows, you grow the stack into multi robot coordination. This is the core the whole company scales on. You own the stack. The Field Robotics Engineer owns what runs at the customer. Each squad includes a Business Intent Owner (BIO), a Technology Orchestrator, Context Engineers, and Harness Engineers. jobs.title: Partner Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Als Partner Manager (m/w/d) bei Enpal Financial Solutions übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für ein eigenes Portfolio an Installateur-Partnern und entwickelst diese Partnerschaften aktiv weiter. Du bist nicht nur Ansprechpartner für unsere Partner, sondern Owner für deren Entwicklung und Erfolg . Du verstehst ihre Geschäftsmodelle und Vertriebsprozesse, analysierst ihre Performance und identifizierst konkrete Hebel, um Aktivierung, Nutzung und Abschlussraten zu steigern. Dabei kombinierst Du Beziehungsmanagement, analytisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Sales-Mentalität . Du gehst proaktiv auf Deine Partner zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen, die einen messbaren Business Impact schaffen. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen und bringst Deine Erkenntnisse aus dem Partnergeschäft aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von EFS ein. Dein Spielfeld Partner Management & Growth Du verantwortest ein eigenes Portfolio an Installateur-Partnern und entwickelst langfristige, erfolgreiche Partnerschaften. Du verstehst die Geschäftsmodelle und Vertriebsprozesse Deiner Partner und identifizierst Potenziale für Wachstum und Aktivierung. Du analysierst die Performance Deines Portfolios anhand relevanter KPIs und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn Partner hinter ihren Möglichkeiten zurückbleiben, und entwickelst proaktiv Lösungen. Du gehst aktiv auf Partner zu und wartest nicht darauf, dass Herausforderungen oder Anfragen bei Dir landen. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern auf und kannst sowohl mit operativen Teams als auch mit Entscheidern auf Augenhöhe kommunizieren. Commercial & Analytical Ownership Du kombinierst Daten und Partner-Insights, um die Entwicklung Deines Portfolios zu verstehen. Du identifizierst Muster, Chancen und Risiken und übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Deinen Partnern Maßnahme

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter Kundenservice (m/w/d) - Vollzeit, bis zu 60% Home Office
jobs.description: Über uns book-n-drive ist einer der führenden regionalen Carsharing-Anbieter. Wir ermöglichen Menschen, flexibel auf ein Auto zuzugreifen, ohne selbst eines besitzen zu müssen. Gemeinsam mit Bus, Bahn und Fahrrad schaffen wir eine praktische Alternative zum eigenen Auto. Wir möchten nicht einfach mehr Menschen zum Autofahren bewegen. Wir möchten Menschen dabei unterstützen, ihren tatsächlichen Mobilitätsbedarf flexibel, wirtschaftlich und möglichst ohne eigenes Auto zu organisieren. Dafür entwickeln wir unseren Kundenservice weiter: Neben der zuverlässigen Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen wollen wir unsere Kunden künftig stärker persönlich begleiten, beraten und langfristig betreuen. Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir eine kommunikative, eigenständige Persönlichkeit, die gerne auf Menschen zugeht, ihre Bedürfnisse versteht und gemeinsam mit ihnen passende Lösungen findet. Deine Aufgaben Kunden aktiv betreuen: Du gehst gezielt auf Kunden zu und unterstützt sie dabei, book-n-drive optimal für ihren Mobilitätsbedarf zu nutzen. Neukunden begleiten: Du hilfst neuen Kunden beim Einstieg, beantwortest Fragen und sorgst dafür, dass sie ihre ersten Erfahrungen mit book-n-drive erfolgreich meistern. Mobilitätsbedarf verstehen: Du findest im Gespräch heraus, wann und wofür Kunden ein Auto benötigen, welche Alternativen sie nutzen und welche Hindernisse einer regelmäßigen Nutzung entgegenstehen. Individuelle Lösungen finden: Du erklärst passende Fahrzeuge, Stationen, Tarife und Angebote und zeigst, wie sich Carsharing sinnvoll mit Bus, Bahn und Fahrrad kombinieren lässt. Kundenbeziehungen entwickeln: Du betreust Kunden auch nach ihren ersten Fahrten, gehst auf Schwierigkeiten ein und hilfst ihnen, book-n-drive dauerhaft und bedarfsgerecht in ihren Alltag zu integrieren. Kundenservice unterstützen: Du bearbeitest auch telefonische und schriftliche Kundenanfragen zu Registrierung, Buchung und Fahrzeugnutzung und unterstützt das Team bei Bedarf im laufenden Service. jobs.title: UX/UI Designer
jobs.description: Introduction: A UX/UI Designer is a professional who combines expertise in user experience and user interface design. You synchronize directly with leading positions based on the teams you are part of. jobs.title: Machine Learning Researcher
jobs.description: About the Position We’re looking for smart and curious individuals to join our growing team and drive our ML work. On our Machine Learning team, you ll build the deep learning models that power our trading strategies, supported by our rapidly growing computing cluster with tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. You’ll train models for the next generation of our deep learning-based trading strategies, and build the fundamental understanding we need to tackle new markets and situations. jobs.title: Machine Learning Performance Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for an engineer with experience in low-level systems programming and optimisation to join our growing ML team.  Machine learning is a critical pillar of Jane Street s global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. Your part here is optimising the performance of our models – both training and inference. We care about efficient large-scale training, low-latency inference in real-time systems and high-throughput inference in research. Part of this is improving straightforward CUDA, but the interesting part needs a whole-systems approach, including storage systems, networking and host- and GPU-level considerations. Zooming in, we also want to ensure our platform makes sense even at the lowest level – is all that throughput actually goodput? Does loading that vector from the L2 cache really take that long? If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in.  There’s no fixed set of skills, but here are some of the things we’re looking for: An understanding of modern ML techniques and toolsets The experience and systems knowledge required to debug a training run’s performance end to end Low-level GPU knowledge of PTX, SASS, warps, cooperative groups, Tensor Cores and the memory hierarchy Debugging and optimisation experience using tools like CUDA GDB, NSight Systems, NSight Computesight-systems and nsight-compute Library knowledge of Triton, CUTLASS, CUB, Thrust, cuDNN and cuBLAS Intuition about the latency and throughput characteristics of CUDA graph launch, tensor core arithmetic, warp-level synchronization and asynchronous memory loads Background in Infiniband, RoCE, GPUDirect, PXN, rail optimisation and NVLin

jobs.description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role Pillar Labs Ltd is LemFi's regulated credit entity, and this is its core compliance hire. You'll sit inside a small, growing second-line function, reporting directly to the Compliance Lead and MLRO (SMF16/SMF17). The role spans the full width of a consumer credit business: day-to-day conduct oversight, financial crime, Consumer Duty, financial promotions, FCA returns and deputy MLRO cover. It's broad by design, because the function is lean and the business is building. This is a hands-on role with real visibility. You'll give practical regulatory advice to Customer Support, Collections and Complaints, review and approve customer-facing content before it goes live, carry out first review of financial crime escalations and internal SARs, and prepare the MI that lands in front of the Board and ExCo. jobs.description: The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT owns the DeepHealth Acute Care CT Suite end to end, with primary accountability for what to build and shared accountability for getting it shipped. DeepHealth is building the Acute Care CT Suite from the ground up to cover detection, care coordination, and reporting for emergency CT, starting with head CT and expanding to chest and abdomen, where minutes saved in stroke, bleeds, and trauma directly affect patient outcomes. The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Product Strategy and Roadmap Own the Acute Care CT Suite roadmap and define what to build, defer, or stop based on evidence. Define suite scope across pathology detection modules, software capabilities such as alerting and care coordination, and comprehensive draft reporting. Work with emergency radiologists and neuro/stroke teams to distinguish stated requests from real clinical needs, including time-to-treatment, triage, missed findings, and care coordination. Translate clinical problems into ML work and set model metrics that reflect clinical value, including sensitivity versus false-positive burden. Track the acute care market (including Aidoc, Viz.ai , RapidAI, Nicolab, and peers) and position products with Sales and Marketing. Delivery and Cross-Functional Execution Own delivery end to end on a subset of the Suite, from data to customer activation, including planning, coordination across data, ML, software, QARA, and Support, tracking, and escalation. Run squads for new devices (typically 3 to 9 months), such as ASPECTS detection. Coordinate with QARA on the regulatory impact of each release, including EU MDR and FDA 510(k). We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a Navigation Engineer within our Precise Navigation team, you will design and develop high-precision navigation and positioning solutions based on tightly-coupled IMU/GNSS filtering, improving localisation accuracy, integrity, and robustness to jamming and spoofing for our autonomous systems – from concept to field deployment. You will work hand-in-hand with the Navigation and Radar teams, as well as software and Electronic Warfare (EW) teams, to deliver robust, resilient Position, Navigation and Timing (PNT) and ensure overall performance, robustness and reliability. Responsibilities Navigation Architecture: Drive the architecture and implementation of navigation / PNT solutions for autonomous platforms. Resilient PNT: Develop navigation resilient to GNSS degradation, jamming and spoofing (anti-jam / anti-spoof). Sensor Fusion: Design multi-sensor fusion (GNSS, INS/IMU, RF, vision) and the associated estimation and filtering algorithms. Testing & Validation: Design test plans (e.g. GNSS receiver testing in jamming environments), run simulations and replays, and report on findings and performance against targets. Technical Coordination: Collaborate across HW, software, EW and ML teams on technical interfaces and system-level trade-offs. System Reviews & Documentation: Contribute to design and architecture reviews and maintain requirements traceability and documentation. Candidate Requiremen
